payload.text: molt maintain on rhadamanth (30 Oct, rhadamanth-sysadm) ran only brew's hook and skipped editors' doom upgrade, exit 0. Likely cause, unproven: cmd_maintain reads its liberator list with while read ... <<< "$liberators" (lib/molt.sh ~2949) and each hook inherits that stdin, so a brew or npm step that reads stdin empties the rest of the list. Fix: hooks run with </dev/null, and a test whose first hook reads stdin. Molt code, on hv's word.
